0.name: Phantom Freelancer
0.col_3: Reminiscences of journeys just begun and those long ended embody the freelancer's myriad supportive techniques.

1.name: Phantom Knight
1.col_3: Emulate these ancient memories of a loyal, honorable knight and defend your comrades from harm.

2.name: Phantom Berserker
2.col_3: Savagery and unfailing courage characterize the recollections of this former berserker. These techniques entail great risk and even greater reward.

3.name: Phantom Monk
3.col_3: These memories of a monk's unflinching discipline and quiet meditation offer a path to unparalleled combat mastery.

4.name: Phantom Ranger
4.col_3: Channel these memories of a proud, passionate ranger and learn to call forth the forces of nature in battle.

5.name: Phantom Samurai
5.col_3: Rigorous training and a strict code of chivalry personify these recollections of an ancient samurai. Access them to fell foes in a single deadly strike.

6.name: Phantom Bard
6.col_3: These memories echo with the vivid imagery of a bard's lilting song. Utilize them to employ the very same ballads in battle.

7.name: Phantom Geomancer
7.col_3: This geomancer's recollections brim with boundless understanding of nature's laws. Access them to employ weather-dependent techniques.

8.name: Phantom Time Mage
8.col_3: The memories of this former time mage reveal much about the laws of time and how to manipulate them to your advantage.

9.name: Phantom Cannoneer
9.col_3: A mastery of ballistics both scholarly and practical infuse this cannoneer's recollections. Emulate them to bombard foes with powerful projectiles.

10.name: Phantom Chemist
10.col_3: This chemist's memories offer knowledge of ancient medicinal theory, including restorative techniques sure to turn the tide of battle in your favor.

11.name: Phantom Oracle
11.col_3: Endowed with an oracle's supernatural senses and prophetic insights, these memories promise mastery over a wealth of supportive skills.

12.name: Phantom Thief
12.col_3: These recollections of a dextrous, principled thief grant access to survival techniques that will doubtless prove useful upon the isle.

13.name: Phantom Mystic Knight
13.col_3: Suffused with a mystic knight's diligence and arcane prowess, these memories are key to imbuing your weaponry with potent magicks.

14.name: Phantom Gladiator
14.col_3: This fierce, indomitable gladiator's recollections promise the mastery of myriad offensive and defensive skills.

15.name: Phantom Dancer
15.col_3: Absorb the memories of an exalted, expressive dancer to replicate their deft footwork and bequeath yourself a range of boons.

16.name: Phantom Ninja
16.col_3: These recollections of a ninja's stealth and stillness will prove useful in a great many precarious situations.

17.name: Phantom White Mage
17.col_3: Attain mastery of restorative techniques with the soothing memories of a devoted white mage.

18.name: Phantom Black Mage
18.col_3: Imbued with a black mage's dedicated research and experimentation, these recollections shall bestow unto you the arcane art of destruction.

19.name: Phantom Dragoon
19.col_3: The memories of a trained dragoon's travels shall teach you to lunge and impale with impunity.

20.name: Phantom Summoner
20.col_3: Channel the reminiscences of an educated, practiced summoner and learn to call forth powerful creatures adept at both offense and defense.

21.name: Phantom Blue Mage
21.col_3: The memories of this world-weary sorcerer are tinged with deep paranoia. Access them to gain monstrous power in arcane form.

22.name: Phantom Red Mage
22.col_3: These recollections of a witty wandering red mage will allow you to wield black and white magicks in perfect balance.

23.name: Phantom Necromancer
23.col_3: Tainted with the tenacity of a desecrated necromancer, these memories promise the power to fight beyond death.
